name: Noble
description: You understand wealth, power, and privilege. You carry a noble title, and your family owns land, collects taxes, and wields significant political influence. You might be a pampered aristocrat unfamiliar with work or discomfort, a former merchant just elevated to the nobility, or a disinherited scoundrel with a disproportionate sense of entitlement. Or you could be an honest, hard-working landowner who cares deeply about the people who live and work on your land, keenly aware of your responsibility to them.

features.name: Noble Proficiencies
features.description: You have proficiency with the following skills: History and Persuasion. You also have proficiency with one type of gaming set of your choice and know one language of your choice.

features.name: Position of Privilege
features.description: Thanks to your noble birth, others are encouraged to give you respect, whether it be genuine or fear of your political power. Once per session, you may announce your title to gain advantage on a Charisma check with another sentient humanoid.
